preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50.
The length of each team name must not exceed 10 characters.
Each team name must contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= goals <= 100 for goals in goals_list)
preconditions.description: The number of goals scored by each team must be between 0 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the names of the top-ranked and second top-ranked teams separated by a space.

postconditions.expression: top_team in team_names and second_team in team_names
postconditions.description: The top-ranked and second top-ranked teams must be valid team names from the input.

postconditions.expression: points[top_team] > points[second_team] or (points[top_team] == points[second_team] and goal_diff[top_team] > goal_diff[second_team])
postconditions.description: The top-ranked team must have more points or, in case of a tie, a higher goal difference than the second top-ranked team.
